output.summary: Evergreen cherry shrub or small to medium-sized tree native to regions bordering the Black Sea in southwestern Asia and southeastern Europe. It has dark green, leathery, shiny leaves that may smell of almonds when crushed, creamy-white sweet-smelling flowers, and small cherries that turn black when ripe in early autumn.
output.edibilityNote: The astringent fruits are edible, but bitter fruits should not be eaten; seeds and leaves contain more hydrogen cyanide and should never be eaten.
